ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987 (Act No. 17 of 1987, as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Acts 1991, 1998, 2008 and 2019); Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (as amended); Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2007; Economic Substance Regulations 2021 (S.I. 2021/05); Samoa International Finance Authority (Beneficial Ownership and Anti-Money Laundering) Rules 2019.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent national authority / licensed notary public in country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all Directors, Shareholders, Ultimate Beneficial Owners and authorised signatories against: (i) United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, (ii) OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, (iii) UK HM Treasury Consolidated List, (iv) Interpol notices, and (v) Samoa's domestic Designated Persons list and Wanted Persons database maintained by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007. Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) trigger Enhanced Due Diligence requiring senior management approval, 90-day continuous transaction monitoring, and mandatory source-of-funds documentary evidence. Any positive match requires immediate filing of a Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) with the Samoa FIU within 24 hours.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) Online Portal – https://www.sifa.ws (Name Search and Name Reservation module; also accessible through MCIL Companies Registry – https://www.mcil.gov.ws)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: A proposed International Company name must be in English or in a language using Latin script. Names in non-Latin script (including Chinese characters) are accepted only if accompanied by a certified Latin-script translation and transliteration ensuring phonetically searchable uniqueness against the SIFA register. The name must include a corporate designator 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Corporation', 'Inc.' or similar accepted abbreviation; the Samoan government requires that any name which is not in English is available for English-language public search via the registry's transliterated index.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: In the event of a name rejection, the applicant or its licensed registered agent may, within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice, file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of International Companies, accompanied by the original name reservation request, the rejection letter, and a written submission distinguishing the proposed name from conflicting marks or prohibited tokens. The Registrar must determine the appeal within 10 business days. If the Registrar upholds the rejection, the applicant may, within further 14 days, apply for judicial review before the Supreme Court of Samoa. A fresh application after rejection requires payment of a new name reservation fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A fully virtual office is not permissible for registration of the International Company. The International Companies Act 1987 requires a physical registered office in Samoa, maintained through a licensed registered agent. For an ISIC 7310 Creator MCN Agency, the operational back-office may be conducted remotely through TikTok Creator Payout and Wise B2B payment rails, but the statutory registered office must remain a physical Samoan street address. A mail-forwarding or co-working virtual address is acceptable as a supplementary correspondence address only.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Estimated at 5% per annum (low risk). SIFA and the Samoan Registrar of International Companies reserve the right of unannounced physical inspection, but in practice they will be triggered only by AML/CFT alerts, adverse media, or inconsistency in the economic substance file. No routine inspection is scheduled for a non-licensed, low-risk MCN agency.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (as consolidated and amended), Part II (Incorporation) ss. 5–12; Part IV (Memorandum and Articles) ss. 15–25; Part VI (Directors) ss. 48–61
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Registrar of International and Foreign Companies, Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form IC-1) together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital; no statutory escrow or capital deposit requirement for an international company
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the Company adopts the issue of 1,000 no-par-value ordinary shares to the initial subscriber as set out in the incorporation application, and the Chief Financial Officer is directed to record such issue as fully paid. FURTHER RESOLVED that the registered office is established at the licensed registered agent's address in Apia, Samoa, with immediate effect upon issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation. FURTHER RESOLVED that [Name] and [Name] are appointed as the first Director and Company Secretary, respectively, each to serve until the next annual general meeting and to exercise all powers delegated by the Articles. FURTHER RESOLVED that any one Director is authorized to execute bank account forms, payment processor agreements, and TikTok Creator payout instructions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA, Registrar of International and Foreign Companies (Online Portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request through the licensed registered agent. The Registrar checks against existing international and domestic company names and reserves the name for 30 days. A formal notarization is not required at this stage, but the proposed name must end with 'Limited' or the approved abbreviation. Pay the reservation fee and obtain the reservation certificate.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form (agent-prepared)
Proposed company name and intended business description
Copy of subscriber's passport or national ID
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for conflict or undesirability, select and submit an alternative name; within 3 calendar days the agent may file an administrative objection with SIFA for reconsideration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent (on behalf of SIFA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a SIFA-licensed registered agent to draft the Memorandum and Articles in accordance with the International Companies Act. The subscriber must sign the Memorandum and Articles in the presence of a notary or authorized witness. The registered agent reviews for statutory compliance and files the completed package with the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (duly executed)
Consent Directive of the initial subscriber
Registered agent engagement letter
Passport copy of each subscriber and proposed director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a query on the constitutional documents, revise the affected clauses and re-submit through the registered agent within 14 days without additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the signed Application for Incorporation (Form IC-1), the Memorandum and Articles, consent of directors, and the registered office consent to SIFA. Pay the official state filing fee of US$100. SIFA examines the package for formal compliance and, if satisfied, proceeds to issue the Certificate of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 (Application for Incorporation of an International Company)
Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent of each director to act
Consent to registered office address from the licensed agent
Filing fee remittance proof
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is returned for correction, the agent cures the defect within 14 days; failure to cure results in a new application with a fresh fee, but the reserved name may be retained upon prompt resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issue of Certificate of Incorporation and Establish Statutory Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation. The registered agent then establishes the statutory registers, including the register of members, directors, charges, and company records. The certificate and registers are maintained at the registered office in Samoa.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation (issued)
Registered agent's confirmation of physical registered office
Shareholder register and director register templates
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate is lost or defective, a certified copy may be requested from SIFA within 5 business days; administrative corrections are processed without penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appoint Officers, Hold First Board Meeting, and Post-Incorporation Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors / Company Secretary (under IC Act 1987)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting (physical or virtual) to adopt the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution, appoint the company secretary, issue share certificates, and authorize execution of bank/agent contracts. File notice of director and secretary appointments with SIFA if required by the Articles. Retain minutes and share certificates in the company records.
required_dossiers: First board meeting minutes (signed)
Pro-Forma First Board Resolution
Appointment of director and secretary forms
Share certificates (specimens)
Registered agent acknowledgement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the director or secretary is non-resident, consular notarization or apostille of the consent forms may be required; if rejected, re-notarize and re-file within 14 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable – the company is an offshore service business with no physical industrial plant or manufacturing facility in Samoa
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No industrial operating license is required for a creator-based MCN agency operating internationally from Samoa

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa – not applicable without a physical project
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (no local operational footprint; zero manufacturing or waste generation)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater discharge, VOC emissions, or hazardous waste generation; digital services produce no regulated environmental emissions under Samoan law.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable – no physical premises in Samoa; the company utilises a licensed registered agent's office only. If a future physical office is opened, the Fire and Emergency Services Authority clearance, building structural clearance from the Samoa Land Corporation, and Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour occupational safety checks will apply.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue, Government of Samoa (successor to the Samoa Revenue Authority under the Ministry for Revenue Act 2022); statutory regulator for income tax, VAGST, and TIN issuance under the Tax Administration Act 2012; official e-services portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws (TIN registration, return filing, and Revenue Information Technology Application).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Samoa International Company must obtain a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) by lodging Form TIN-01 with the Ministry for Revenue, accompanied by the Certificate of Incorporation under the International Companies Act 2014, registered office address in Apia, certified passport copies of directors and ultimate beneficial owners, a licensed Samoa resident agent engagement letter, and beneficial ownership declarations; a foreign entity without a Samoa fixed establishment registers through a licensed resident agent and typically receives the TIN within 3–5 business days; a separate VAGST registration number must be obtained if the entity makes taxable supplies exceeding the threshold or elects voluntary registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: A Samoa International Company is statutorily exempt from all Samoan national and municipal taxation on income, capital gains, VAGST, stamp duty, and estate/gift duties under section 202 of the International Companies Act 2014, conditioned upon maintaining offshore-only activity, satisfying annual license fee and economic substance filing obligations, and not carrying on local business through a fixed place of business in Samoa.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: An IC may elect by special resolution or constitutional notice to waive the section 202 tax exemption and be assessed as a resident Samoa company under the Income Tax Act 2015; alternatively it may redomicile and continue as a foreign company under the Companies Act 2001. There is no US-style check-the-box election; Samoa's BEPS-aligned controlled-foreign-company, transfer-pricing, and anti-hybrid rules may reclassify or deny the exemption in abuse cases. For VAGST purposes, an IC may voluntarily register even below the WST 100,000 threshold, and related entities may elect consolidated group VAGST registration.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST (Value Added Goods and Services Tax) — a destination-based consumption tax under the Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 1996, administered by the Ministry for Revenue.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 (Samoan Tala) of taxable supplies in any rolling 12-month period (threshold raised from WST 60,000 to WST 100,000 effective 2016); voluntary registration is permitted; a foreign supplier with no Samoa fixed establishment triggering reverse-charge obligations must register if supplying digital or electronically supplied services to Samoa-resident consumers.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, continuous audit transaction controls, e-invoicing API, or digital stamping mandate applies in Samoa (in contrast to Latin American and Middle Eastern regimes). Taxpayers must issue a prescribed VAGST tax invoice showing supplier name and TIN, recipient name and TIN, description of supply, invoice date, and separately stated 15% VAGST, and file VAGST returns electronically through the Ministry for Revenue e-services portal on a bimonthly basis; source records must be retained for 7 years and may be required in XML or system-generated format during audit.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to (1) goods physically exported from Samoa by the supplier before first supply to a Samoa resident; (2) services supplied to a non-resident recipient who is outside Samoa at the time of supply and who derives no direct or indirect benefit from the service in Samoa; and (3) services supplied in connection with offshore goods or to foreign-going ships or aircraft. A TikTok MCN agency may zero-rate global creator-commission, talent-management, and offshore digital marketing services supplied to overseas creator affiliates and non-resident TikTok commercial counterparties, provided the service is performed wholly outside Samoa, no part is consumed by a Samoa-resident office, and contemporaneous documentation establishes the offshore supply chain. An IC enjoying the section 202 exemption remains wholly outside the VAGST net; zero-rating becomes relevant where the operating entity is a local Samoa company or an electing IC.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World electronic submission via Samoa Department of Customs and Excise)
Commercial Invoice or VAGST Tax Invoice marked 'Zero-rated supply' with all TIN references
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export of goods from Samoa
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT MT103 from a Samoa-licensed commercial bank evidencing foreign-currency receipt
Packing List and Certificate of Origin (where cargo is exported)
Service Contract, performance log, and reconciliation statement evidencing offshore service delivery (for zero-rated services)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Ministry for Revenue may reassess and claw back zero-rated supplies within a 6-year reassessment window where documentation is incomplete, false, or fails to establish physical export or offshore recipient status; civil shortfall penalties of up to 100% of the unpaid VAGST may be imposed together with continuing monthly late-payment interest of 1.5%, cancellation of zero-rating approval, and disqualification of the exporter; fraudulent zero-rating claims constitute tax evasion under the Tax Administration Act 2012, punishable by criminal fines and/or imprisonment, public disclosure of the delinquent taxpayer, and loss of the IC exemption for the period concerned.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS); the national monetary authority and exchange control regulator, exercising delegated powers under the Exchange Control Act 1976, the Central Bank of Samoa Act 1984, and the financial integrity framework overseen by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan tālā (WST) is a managed-float currency that is not freely tradable offshore; all onshore WST conversions must be executed through CBS-licensed authorised dealers. Current-account payments, including creator management fees and royalties, are generally permitted on submission of supporting commercial documentation. Capital-account transactions, such as equity injections, dividends, and profit repatriation, require prior exchange-control approval or coverage under a gazetted general permission. For a tax-exempt International Company, profit remittance hurdles are moderate but manageable: audited financial statements evidencing accumulated surplus, a registered-agent confirmation that the company has not transacted with Samoa residents, and a CBS remittance approval for the specific outflow.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Samoa's Exchange Control Regulations, export proceeds must be repatriated to Samoa within 90 days of export and surrendered to an authorised dealer in WST at the prevailing market rate, unless the CBS grants a foreign-currency retention licence. The default statutory conversion ratio is 100% of export receipts. For an offshore MCN agency receiving digital advertising and creator management revenue in USD, the CBS routinely grants an annual foreign-currency retention approval to allow the company to keep USD for subsequent offshore disbursements, subject to quarterly balance-of-payments and exchange-control reporting.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account — WST/USD

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility with defined legal constraints. Samoa does not license electronic money institutions, and offshore digital EMIs such as Wise B2B are not authorised dealers under Samoa's exchange-control regime. They may be used lawfully as disbursement rails for creator payouts, but the primary treasury account must remain with a CBS-licensed commercial bank for foreign-currency conversion and regulatory reporting. The EMI engagement should be structured as a non-deposit, contractual payment-agent service located outside Samoa, with explicit wording that it is not conducting banking business in Samoa.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical director presence is not statutorily mandated for corporate account opening in Samoa. Licensed banks generally accept remote onboarding where directors complete a video KYC interview, provide certified copies of passports and corporate documents, and submit a notarised board resolution. The Registered Agent in Samoa must also issue a certificate of good standing and a due-diligence confirmation. A notarised power of attorney is normally required for non-resident directors; some banks may request one physical visit by a director or an independent interviewer in the director's jurisdiction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore shell risk — Samoa International Company with no local employees, no physical presence, and no economic activity in Samoa.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Samoa Companies Registry extract; International Company Certificate; Registered Agent agreement; constitutional documents confirming no resident transactions; group structure chart with ultimate beneficial owner detail; audited financial statements or management accounts; operating contracts with TikTok, creator management agreements, and platform payout reports.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unlicensed money transmission — frequent micro-payments to numerous non-resident creators via Wise B2B or e-wallets.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed creator representation agreements; TikTok payout statements; matching invoices and settlement receipts; independent legal opinion confirming the activity is talent management rather than money transmission; internal KYC/AML file for every creator; client-fund segregation policy; transaction monitoring and escalation logs.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Suspected structuring — deliberate splitting of high-value capital injections to stay below CBS reporting thresholds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution authorising the capital injection; treasury policy prohibiting split transactions; single high-value SWIFT MT103 message; shareholder source-of-wealth declaration; prior written communications with the bank's compliance team; automated aggregation monitoring evidence; CBS inward-remittance forms if triggered.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Exchange-control evasion — irregular USD retention, undocumented outbound payments, and failure to report foreign currency holdings.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: CBS foreign-currency retention licence; quarterly BOPS/EC reports; authorised-dealer conversion slips; board-approved disbursement policies; tax-compliance certificate; audited financial statements showing all payments are creator royalties or operational costs; legal classification of the outbound flows as current-account payments.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Use a single SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder or operating parent to the Samoa IC's USD operational account. Field 70 must state 'CAPITAL INJECTION — WS_IC' and the receiving bank must file an Inward Remittance Application using balance-of-payments code E2 for direct investment equity. CBS prior approval is not required for fresh equity in a non-resident International Company, but all inward credits at or above USD 50,000 must be reported to CBS. Supporting documents include the Certificate of Good Standing, Register of Members, board resolution authorising the capital call, shareholder source-of-funds declaration, and, for amounts exceeding USD 1 million, audited financial statements. The payment must never be split into smaller instalments to avoid screening; structuring will trigger an automatic suspicious-transaction report.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The primary clearing rail is SWIFT MT103 clean payment from the Samoan treasury account to each creator's or vendor's bank, with field 70 referencing the underlying MCN contract and invoice. For high-frequency, low-value creator payouts, a pre-funded pooled account at Wise B2B or an equivalent licensed offshore EMI is recommended: the Samoan bank initiates one MT103 'Pool Funding' payment to the EMI's collection account, and the EMI performs the individual disbursements through its local rails. Commercial Letters of Credit are not applicable to MCN talent-management services; clean payments or documentary remittances are the accepted instruments. Every outbound MT103 must be screened against UN, OFAC, and EU sanctions lists and, when the aggregate outflow exceeds WST 100,000, must be accompanied by the bank's Foreign Payment Application to comply with exchange-control reporting.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Forward foreign exchange contract (USD/WST) with an authorised dealer, tenor up to 12 months, linked to identified receivables or payables.
Non-deliverable forward (NDF) on WST/USD with a licensed offshore counterparty, settled in USD, used solely to hedge a documented Samoan tālā exposure.
Cross-currency swap (USD/WST) to hedge foreign-currency borrowings or to re-denominate capital inflows, subject to CBS prior approval.
FX vanilla option (purchased only) on USD/WST to protect a minimum conversion rate for creator revenue, provided the option is trade-related and not speculative.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Annual License Fee Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before each anniversary of incorporation; a 30-day grace period may be available under administrative practice
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 10% of the annual fee per month or part thereof; continued default triggers Registrar's warning, suspension of filing status, and administrative strike-off of the International Company

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is compulsory for a standard International Company solely on the basis of corporate form; audit becomes mandatory only if the company's articles so require, the company is licensed under a regulated activity, or the Registrar issues a specific direction on reasonable grounds
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory statutory accounting framework for International Companies; financial records may be maintained under IFRS or other generally accepted accounting principles as selected by the directors, subject to any audit direction or license condition

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The annual return confirms the current members and shareholding structure; beneficial ownership information is not separately filed with the Registrar but must be obtained and continuously maintained by the licensed registered agent under Samoa AML/CFT obligations. Any share transfer affecting the register of members must be recorded before the next annual return.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 - USD 5,000 per engagement if voluntarily or externally required

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption from Samoan corporate income tax on offshore/international income for International Companies under the International Companies Act 2008; exemption from withholding tax on exempt distributions; no Samoan GST/VAT on qualifying international business income; reduced regulatory fees for licensed international companies; exemption from exchange control restrictions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Samoan corporate income tax return is required for a tax-exempt International Company. The sole recurring filing obligation is the IC Annual Return (Form IC-AR) submitted through the Samoa International Financial Services Authority (SIFSA) online e-Registry portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after the anniversary of incorporation, unless extended by the Registrar of International Companies. Annual license fees are due before 31 December each calendar year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name and International Company registration number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact name and registration number as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation.
Provide the street address of the Samoan registered office maintained by the licensed registered agent; no P.O. Box alone is sufficient.
The registered agent must complete this box with its SIFSA license number and contact details.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Issued share capital and classes of shares
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List all classes of shares, number issued, and nominal value; bearer shares must be identified if held by non-residents.
Provide full names, nationality, residential address, and passport number for each director and secretary; non-resident directors are permitted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of no Samoan-source taxable income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm that the International Company has not derived income from Samoan sources during the reporting period; if any Samoan-source income exists, the exempt status may be jeopardized.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Related-party transactions and transfer pricing self-assessment
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare whether any transactions occurred with connected enterprises outside Samoa; mark N/A if all transactions are foreign-source and no Samoan tax deduction is claimed.
The licensed registered agent certifies that the company has maintained statutory records, an office, and that the annual fee is paid.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the IC Annual Return attracts a fixed penalty of USD 500 plus a daily surcharge of USD 20. Failure to pay the annual license fee by 31 December results in automatic strike-off from the International Companies Register, restoration fees, and possible personal liability of directors for continuing trading.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for dividends and distributions paid by a tax-exempt Samoan International Company from offshore international income. The standard Samoan dividend withholding tax rate is 15%, but the IC exemption removes distributions by an exempt IC from the Samoan WHT net.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Where the IC is not exempt or where a payment has inadvertently been subjected to Samoan WHT, treaty relief is claimed by: (1) obtaining a Samoan Tax Residency Certificate from the Ministry of Revenue; (2) obtaining the beneficial owner's official tax residency certificate from the counterparty jurisdiction; (3) submitting the prescribed withholding tax exemption/relief application form to the payer before the payment date; and (4) maintaining documentary evidence of the 10% or 5% treaty-reduced rate, if applicable. Samoa may also require an annual reconciliation of WHT claims through the tax administration portal.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Samoan WHT on non-resident royalties and interest is 15% each. Under applicable double taxation agreements, the rate may be reduced to 5% or 10% depending on the treaty and recipient category. For a tax-exempt International Company, inbound foreign-source royalties and interest are not subject to Samoan income tax or WHT, and outbound payments made by the IC from exempt foreign-source income are not subject to Samoan WHT.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable to a tax-exempt International Company deriving only foreign-source international income. If an IC becomes subject to Samoan tax, transfer pricing documentation is required when the aggregate annual related-party transaction value exceeds WST 2 million or the entity enters into transactions with non-resident connected persons exceeding WST 500,000 in any single recordable transaction.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Samoa Economic Substance Regulations apply to International Companies carrying on relevant activities such as distribution and service provision, financing, headquarters, and intellectual property holding. A global TikTok MCN agency providing creator management, brand representation, licensing, and marketing services is treated as a service-provision business and therefore must demonstrate economic substance in Samoa: a physical office or premises, at least one locally engaged officer or employee capable of making strategic decisions, board meetings held and minuted in Samoa, and core income-generating activities conducted in Samoa. Pure shell companies without Samoan administrative presence or board control are subject to ESR penalties, substantive recharacterization, and possible loss of exempt status.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Misrepresentation of Foreign-Source Income
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the International Company to conceal economic ownership while deriving Samoan-source revenue from local TikTok creator contracts, or falsely declaring 'no Samoan-source income' in the annual return when the IC is managed and controlled from Samoa or earns income connected to Samoan operations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of 150% of the tax shortfall plus a fine of up to WST 300,000 under the Income Tax Ordinance 2012; criminal prosecution for tax evasion carrying imprisonment of up to 7 years; mandatory reassessment at the 27% corporate rate; freezing of bank accounts and attachment of digital payment rails such as Wise B2B and TikTok Creator payouts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly sign false declarations are jointly and severally liable for the company's unpaid tax, penalties, and interest. Directors may be subjected to travel bans, prohibition orders, disqualification from acting as directors for up to 10 years, civil restitution to the Revenue Authority, and personal imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company with No Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC as a pure conduit for worldwide creator fees and licensing income without maintaining a physical office, Samoan board meetings, qualified staff, or records demonstrating direction and control in Samoa, while still claiming exemption from Samoan tax and treaty benefits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: SIFSA may impose administrative penalties of up to WST 250,000, order strike-off from the International Companies Register, cancel the tax exemption, and reassess income at the standard 27% corporate rate with late payment surcharges; repeated violations result in mandatory liquidation of the IC and barring of the registered agent from representing new companies.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the registered agent may be held personally liable for withdrawal of the company's license, restoration costs, and unpaid taxes. Directors face civil liability for fraudulent trading, personal asset freezes, disqualification for up to 10 years, and imprisonment if the sham structure is used to defraud creditors or tax authorities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Violations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving TikTok creator payouts, performance bonuses, and Wise B2B remittances through the Samoan IC without implementing customer due diligence, beneficial ownership screening, transaction monitoring, or suspicious transaction reporting; layering creator proceeds through multiple nominee directors or foreign shell accounts to obscure the economic beneficiary.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism Act 2017 as amended, a body corporate may be fined up to WST 1 million per offense; business operations may be suspended; funds and virtual assets may be frozen or confiscated; and criminal prosecution may lead to imprisonment of responsible individuals for up to 10 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally fined up to WST 100,000, subjected to travel bans, and disqualified from holding financial services licenses. Where directors knowingly participate in money laundering or fail to report suspicious transactions, they face criminal conviction, confiscation of personal and corporate assets, and imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False Annual Return and Fraudulent Trading
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly submitting an annual return that misstates shareholders, directors, registered office substance, related-party transactions, or Samoan income; continuing to trade as an International Company while struck off for non-payment of fees; using the IC to defraud creators, advertisers, or foreign tax authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary fines of up to WST 50,000 per false statement, automatic late-filing surcharges of USD 20 per day, court-ordered strike-off, revocation of the IC certificate, and liability in civil proceedings for damages to aggrieved parties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign or cause the filing of false returns are personally liable for all penalties, damages, and costs. The court may impose personal contribution orders, travel bans, disqualification from managing any Samoan company for up to 10 years, and imprisonment of up to 2 years for fraudulent trading.
